# Release record – 0.2.1 (2026-10-30)

The 0.2.0 pilots' fixes: closed markets resolve (TP-9), a flat run stays
healthy (TP-10), the late-day weather model is priced from the day itself
(TP-11) and one day's bets are capped (TP-12). Pre-registration of the two
pilots that start with this release ([`GO-NO-GO.md` §3.2](../RELEASE-GATE.md#32-pre-registration-every-stage)).
**Do not edit the pre-registered files after the start.** A changed hash
means a new pilot with a new record.

## Code

| Repository | Commit | Tag |
|---|---|---|
| trading-polymarket | `4aeb3b0` (code: `main` after TP-9..TP-12); the release commit adds the version, configs and this record; the tag goes on its merge | `v0.2.1` |
| trading-core | `e64526bfdd2c4918e7cf8eb63116e5a64da13e98` | `v0.2.2` |

The pilots run from tagged copies with their own venv:
`runtime-trading/bin/install-release.sh v0.2.2 v0.2.1` clones both tags
into `runtime-trading/releases/` and installs them into
`runtime-trading/venvs/polymarket-v0.2.1/`. Each pilot runs in the
foreground with `bin/run.sh <config> polymarket-v0.2.1`, which appends the
versions, commits and hashes it ran with to the pilot's `RUN.txt`
(`runtime-trading/README.md`).

## What the 0.2.0 pilots showed

Both started 2026-10-29 10:48 UTC and were stopped 2026-10-30; neither is
judged (review: `claude/polymarket-pilots-review-2026-10-30.md` in the
project).

- **weather-0.2.0**: 10 positions, all on one thesis (the day's maximum
  still rises ≥ 1 °C after 15:00 local), all lost: −$99.8. The breaker
  tripped and liquidated five; five more could not resolve (TP-9); then the
  engine stalled on stale market data (TP-10). This is evidence against the
  0.2.0 late-day model (TP-11), not a void day.
- **fed-0.2.0**: one trade (−$0.30), then stalled on stale market data from
  16:06 local on day 1 (TP-10).

## Stage 0 for the TP-11 weather model

Intraday replay (`backtest weather --intraday`) on
`data/history/weather-intraday.jsonl` (757 events, 12–27 Oct 2026; 542 with
forecasts and METARs), pilot lane settings, half-spread 0.01, verdict with
`configs/verdict/weather.json`:

| Entry | Positions | Adjusted net | Verdict | Brier: model / market / blend |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15:00 local | 306 | +$1,102.70 | GO | 0.0271 / 0.0306 / 0.0253 |
| 16:00 local | 158 | +$1,213.88 | GO | 0.0149 / 0.0205 / 0.0143 |

The 0.2.0 model on the same replay: Brier 0.0318 / 0.0193 (worse than the
market at 15:00).

Read this with three limits:
- `today_error_weight` and `intraday_sigma` were chosen on this window
  (checked on each half against the other, [`RESEARCH.md` §6](../../RESEARCH.md#6-results-log)),
  so it is not out of sample;
- prices are hourly mids, not the book;
- the replay has no per-day cap: the pilot takes at most 3 a day.

The pilot is the out-of-sample test.

Not pre-registered: `configs/smoke-0.2.1.json` (the smoke run; data under
`data/smoke/`, never judged).

The `run_started` record of each pilot's `audit.jsonl` carries
`config_file_sha256`, and `RUN.txt` the config's, the rules' and the bias
table's; all must match the table.

**Sample.** The weather pilot needs 150 positions; at 3 a day that takes
about seven weeks (decided 2026-10-30: keep the cap and the sample). The fed
pilot needs 60.

**Bias table.** From 0.2.1 the weather model uses the bias table only for
the hours before a day's first METAR (TP-11). This pilot trades from 15:00
local, when every station has reported, so the table does not price its
entries: there are no weekly rebuilds or restarts during this pilot. The
hash above is recorded for completeness.

## Read-out

To be filled at the end of each pilot (weather: 150 positions, about seven
weeks; fed: 60 positions; both at least 3 weeks after `run_started`):
verdict, failed checks, positions, net, positive days; for weather the
intraday Brier scores on the METAR archive and how often the day cap bound;
for fed the share of exits by convergence vs resolution.
